params.body:
On the Observatory's Accounts page, "Make the account" fails with "Not made: The server answered 419".

The pipeline posts to `POST /internal/accounts` (added in #224). The CSRF exemption in `bootstrap/app.php` lists `internal/accounts/*`, and that pattern does not match the bare path, so Laravel refuses the signed request as a CSRF failure. Updating a plan (`/internal/accounts/{user}`) and deleting (`/internal/accounts/{user}/delete`) both match the wildcard, which is why they work.

- Adds `internal/accounts` to the exemption list. The route stays protected by the HMAC signature and the five-minute window, like the others.
- Laravel skips CSRF checks while tests run, so the feature tests could not catch this. A new case in `WebhookCsrfTest` checks every accounts path the pipeline posts to against the exemption list. It fails without the fix.

params.title: Making a test account no longer answers 419
